positions.name: PallasineChecklistAuthority
positions.frame: What makes the Pallasine checklist the settled, legitimate onboarding standard rather than just one more procedure among others?
positions.why: Both expressions carry the same authority-ranking, legitimacy-drawing register the dimensional passes flag: src-1 states the checklist as a universal mandate every new hire completes, and src-2 asserts its supersession of the prior wiki-page system. Read together, the pair does the work of establishing the checklist's standing — not merely describing its contents but asserting its displacement of a predecessor and its unhedged, flat-fact delivery as settled institutional order. The tension held here is between description (what the checklist contains) and provenance (why it now holds authority) — the frame reads both as answering the same underlying question of legitimacy.
